reviews.text: Best groomers ever!  I’m so  particular about where I take my dog. These people are so friendly and loving to the dogs. It’s a beautiful, and clean salon. I found the perfect place I’m so happy!
Zoey found her new stylist!! 5 stars across the board! Professionalism A tier! Definitely recommend!!

Great Experience!

I had a wonderful experience at I Pet You Grooming. The staff was friendly, gentle, and treated my dog with so much care. The groom came out perfect clean, cute, and smelling fresh! Highly recommend! 🐾✨  Haylie  looks like a brand new dog ! Before and after pics below !

Loved the results and she had alot of energy and brought her toys to me at home after her grooming session which was different for me to see! My dog came back to me in one piece and full of energy after her first visit. She did not even pant in the car ride home which was unusual. Thank you Khaled for your warmness and great customer service with my Ginger.
My Chance looks so Handsome. Thank you all for taking care of him and making his first time amazing. We have definitely found our new Grooming spot😎🐶🐩
Always does a great job with my Doodle! Very quick and communicative!
Excellent service!!!
They did an amazing job with my dog

I took my Shih Tzu Poodle mix here for his first grooming session. From the moment I set the appointment, I knew I made the right decision (the 200+ 5 star reviews were also a clear indicator lol). The owner was very pleasant when we arrived and greeted my puppy with so much enthusiasm! I knew he’d be in great hands. Pricing was very reasonable and he even gave us a first timer gift. Can’t wait to continue my puppies grooming journey with I Pet Grooming!

My maltipoo HATES being groomed and holds a grudge whenever I take her to get beautified. This time she came out pretty happy and looking fabulous with her cute lil pom-poms and no accidental injuries. Khaled is so personable, or let’s say PETsonable 😆 I felt my baby was in good hands, and he takes every dog very personal. Definitely will come back for crazier haircuts.

Wonderful groomer experience this was our puppies first time being Groomed and exactly what we asked for as exactly what we got. The staff was wonderful. I forgot the guy’s name who attended us, but you can just tell they love what they do and they treat the Dogs with nothing but love, which is great to see when you bring the pets 10 out of 10 recommend

The best groomer in Houston! I’ve been coming here for my doodle for a few years now and the customer service and grooming has always been amazing! My dog is a little timid with men but here she always goes in easily and  comes out happy! Anytime we lack on brushing and my doodle gets matted they do a perfect restart without any bruising or nicks,  I would highly recommend :)
I highly recommend it♥️

I had a great experience bringing my puppy here for grooming! They did an amazing job as i hoped and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a good pet grooming. I'll definitely be coming back!

We love I Pet You for our two doodles! Not only are they reasonably priced and provide an excellent service but they are incredibly kind. They remember our family and welcome us warmly every time we bring our dogs in for a groom. Recommend!
The best in Houston, TX, super friendly and attentive. My dog ​​son leaves happy with his haircut.

This was my first time bringing my baby to a groomer since moving here last year because I’m very picky, but Khalid did not disappoint! He was incredibly friendly and took the time to listen to my concerns about my 5-year-old Doxie’s sensitive skin.
When I picked my baby up his coat was so shiny and soft, I could immediately tell the care and attention that went into the grooming. And the bow was the perfect finishing touch!
Highly recommend if you’re looking for someone who truly cares about your pet.
So kind, good groom!
They did such a wonderful dog with my dog for his grooming services. I really appreciated how kind and patient they were with him. I can’t wait to bring him back. 10/10 customer service
The best grooming! It's the best decision I made for my Pomeranian. They cut her beautiful fur, leaving her smelling amazing, and they treat her with so much love at a reasonable price. 👌🏽🥰😍😄🫶🏽 …
100% DELIGHTED! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM. THEY TREATED ME AND ESPECIALLY MY DOG EXCELLENTLY. 🙏💕 I 100% RECOMMEND THEM. QUALITY AND CLASS ARE UNBEATABLE. …
Mr Khaled and Ms Laila have been fantastic in taking care of Penny today! Extremely professional and clean! Thank you all so much for taking care of my family pet!

Took my golden doodle in today and he was an absolute hot mess 😅

From the start, they were honest about what needed to be done and made sure I understood everything before getting started. They took their time, didn’t rush the process, and truly took care of my dog the right way.

The result? He looks amazing and, more importantly, he’s super happy.

You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs they work with. Highly recommend if you want someone who’s honest, patient, and does great work.
I called and he remembered me instantly— that kind of tailored service is unmatched and TOP QUALITY! very professional and my puppy enjoys ✨ thank you
It's was amazing!
Best groomer ! He loves dogs!

I absolutely love I Pet You Grooming! The service is always great, and Khaled is incredibly welcoming and kind. He truly cares about the dogs and it shows in his work. My dog, Peanut, always comes home with the most beautiful haircut and looking so fresh and happy. Highly recommend this place to any pet parent looking for excellent grooming and friendly service! 🐶✂️💙
Amazing work ! Great place to take ur dog for grooming !!

We took Lily to iPet You Grooming for the first time since moving to the area, and I can honestly say we’re so happy we found this place. We were nervous trying a new groomer, but the moment we met Khaled Mohamed, all of that went away. He was incredibly kind and so gentle with Lily.

They even sent us pictures while she was there and let us know how she was doing, which meant so much to us. Lily came home looking adorable, smelling amazing, and clearly very well cared for. You can really tell they love the dogs and treat them like their own.

We’re beyond grateful to have found iPet You Grooming and will absolutely be bringing Lily back. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares. 🐾❤️

We moved to the area and tried this place based on the reviews, and we're so glad we did. We've brought our 70 pound pup a few times for grooming, each time he came back clean, trimmed, and smelled good for weeks. Every time you call and walk in the door they know you by name and provide amazing customer service. We will continue to come back for more grooming and highly recommend their services to others.
I was always delighted; my baby always looks beautiful thanks to the work of this team and Khaled.

I Pet You Grooming did a fabulous job with our beautiful girl Sasha! She was treated with so much care and kindness. We will be back!

Just wanted to update on Sasha’s second groom! The team did a fabulous job with her! Repeat customers for life here!
Delighted 🥰

Wow! I Pet You grooming is a top notch, clean, FRIENDLY, and reasonably priced place that I highly recommend. I would rate them more than 5 stars…thank you for making this experience the best I’ve had when it comes to my pup!

i honestly can’t thank this place enough. for the longest time i thought no one could give Boone a good groom because he’s scared of scissors and clippers - but they proved me wrong. the staff are very professional and made sure he was comfortable and safe, as well as ensuring their own safety. Boone looks so handsome and happy. we’ll definitely be coming back routinely!

I finally found a designated groomer for my dog Cheveyo. When you walk in the place is clean and it smells nice. I’ve been to a couple of groomers before and they were nothing like I Pet You Grooming. Timing was precise and pick up was on point. My Chevy came out looking like a whole new puppy! I am so pleased with the their service. The owner was very nice and kind. You can tell that he is a dog lover and that made me more comfortable in leaving him in his hands. Thank you much!

Everyone is very friendly and helpful. We have a german shepherd and an english Labrador, and the technician has done a wonderful job. Their coat is soft and smells amazing, they’re using very nice pet colognes. The service was fast and very reasonable priced. We definitely recommend!!
Excellent service and very good attention to the customer and the animals

We have become regulars here! Khaled is amazing and so welcoming. When we first came, he was very transparent about prices and also made Rockie and I feel comfortable. Rockie usually gets nervous when it comes to baths, but he seems happy to see Khaled! The salon always does a great job on Rockie, and he stays smelling good for approximately one week. He also always leaves with a cute little accessory. We highly recommend I Pet You grooming! Rockie approved!

I’m so happy with the grooming service! The staff was friendly, gentle, and patient with my dog, and you can tell they truly love animals. My dogs came out looking amazing—clean, soft, and perfectly groomed. The whole process was smooth I’ll definitely be bringing my dog back here and recommending them to friends!

First time here and omg they welcome was very big. The owner made you feel like family. He knows knows how to deal with the dogs. They made my baby look gorgeous. Husband was very impressed too. Definitely give them a try. Oh and they sell doggy clothes. I wanted to take them all.
My Bichon looks beautiful! The grooming is  professional , friendly and in a timely manner!
My 10-year-poodle got his grooming here, and I absolutely love the place. He came back looking like a teddy bear!

It’s a great place. Absolutely if there is more than five star I will give them great staff. They do great job. I love the way the greeting you they will come you and the job that they do. I will recommend it for everybody to have the same experience I had.
Great service, very Clean and reliable, reasonable prices . Highly recommended

If your looking for a family type of groomer, these guys are it. I was super nervous as last groomer didn't hold up and located this place and gave them a try. My peanut was so happy after words which tells me he definitely wants to go back. They did just what I asked for. Great groomers, ty so much.

I LOVE THIS PLACE FOR MY MALTESE COCO. IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A GROOMER FOR YOUR BABY DOG… GO HERE! ITS CLEAN, PROFESSIONAL AND CARING. IT HAVE AN OPEN VIEW WHERE YOU CAN SEE WHAT ARE THEY DOING TO YOUR PET. NOT LIKE OTHER PLACES.
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND I PET YOU!!!!
WE BEEN LOYALTY CUSTOMERS FOR AROUND 3 YEARS. ( I PET YOU ) ALSO OFFERS A HUGE VARIETY OF CUTE PET OUTFITS AND ACCESSORIES.

This is by far the best pet groomer I have ever been to! Not only does my doggy Rico look and smell amazing every time but you can tell that Khaled and everyone who works there really genuinely cares about all pets! Rico is always excited to see him too! It’s a good feeling knowing my dog is in good hands!
We take our doodles here and Khaled and his team do a BEAUTIFUL job every single time! They take their time and treat them with love!!

Khaled was able to squeeze us in for an AM appointment from the day before. Very professional, sweet and reassuring. Never been to a dog groomer before, so the small dog pricing was a surprise at how much was included. Frankie even came out with a little yellow flower accessory that compliments her black fur. Definitely coming in again, and I was so pleased I left a tip for the patient groomer that dealt with Frankie lol
We are so thankful we found Khalid! My mind & my heart are eased..
They groomed our pup and he came back looking and smelling great. Friendly staff. 2nd time here and will use them again in the future.
First time took my puppy they did a awesome amazing job will be back definitely
My golden retriever arrived with severe allergies, and thanks to your allergy bath service, he came out looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. Thank you so much for your service!

This place is always exceptional!  The owner is hands on and loves animals very much.   You can feel that when you drop your pet off it will be well taken care of.   Thank you for always do a great job on my dogs.  I have two dogs.  The boss my dog Bella a chihuahua and the my other dog Max the Great Pyrenees. One is 10 lbs and the other 110 lbs.  they always do a phenomenal job.  Thanks.

Excellent service, very kind and attentive, thank you so much Khaled!
My dog ​​looked beautiful.
Well, what can I say! They are the best! My utmost respect! They made my baby look beautiful and were super fast. Highly recommended, friendly, and a great price.

It's the first time I've taken my Frenchs to a professional grooming precisely for fear that they won't be treated well, but I can say that they are as safe as with me. I loved the attention they give them from the moment you arrive, the cleanliness and the delicious smell with which they are without a doubt I recommend this place to pamper your 4-legged friends.

We've taken our Australian Shepherd, Lyla, to Khaled four times now, and each visit has exceeded our expectations. Every time we arrive, Khaled greets her with such joy, and she always comes out looking like a brand new pup. The transformation is incredible, and she smells amazing! We're so grateful to have found this place; we know we can trust them completely with our girl. Their work is truly outstanding! (Here are some photos of all the times we went)
The customer service and service provided is unmatched!! When I find service like this I am loyal. I will go no where else. Highly recommend!!
Our dog has never looked better! I Pet You Grooming always does a great job!

Keith, my American Stafforshire Terrier has been groomed at Petsmart since 2017.  Recently Keith did not allow groomers to trim his nails.  Not sure, but I think they may have cut too close.  Khaled was so gentle with Keith and knows how to keep the environment calm. He was able to trim Keith's  nails.  I am happy to say Khaled is Keith's new groomer.  I highly recommend  I Pet you Grooming. We are very satisfied customers.
Ellie looks and smells great
The best groomer in Houston. Patient kind and memorable. If you want great service and hospitality please don’t waste time and go to I pet you grooming.
